up: Retrieve compound ChEMBL IDs, canonical SMILES, and exact activity values (standard_value, standard_units, standard_type) for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4888486. Filter activities to include only exact values where standard_relation equals '=' and standard_value is not null. Join assays (chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4888486') to activities on assay_id, activities to compound_structures on molregno, and compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Return distinct results without any row limits or ranking.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4888486' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
